svg.metadata: {"revision": 1, "concept_id": "edu.simple-leaf-blade-outline", "source_contract": "planning/tactile-masters/source-contract.json", "profiles": ["swell-paper-v1", "index-embossed-v1", "viewplus-variable-height-v1"], "design": "Simplified smooth-margin single leaf blade with attached petiole. Veins/branch/buds omitted. Example for contour reading, not universal simple-leaf shape or independent species/simple-versus-compound classification.", "geometry_exception": "Index explicitly samples line/area geometry into graphics dots; compatible continuous geometry is shared by swell and ViewPlus.", "physical_evaluation": "pending", "viewplus_shading_revision": {"date": "2026-11-06", "fill": "#808080", "purpose": "Mark actual leaf blade, flower or plant silhouette area below the unchanged black boundaries and veins, so the plant region differs from the unraised surrounding space; gaps between separate leaves remain white.", "geometry_changed": false, "physical_testing": "pending", "human_review_of_revision": "pending"}}

g.data-exception-reason: Single-height dot placement preserves line extent or area/rim extent; no gray encoding and no generic Braille-cell art.

use.data-design-purpose: Mark actual leaf blade, flower or plant silhouette area below the unchanged black boundaries and veins, so the plant region differs from the unraised surrounding space; gaps between separate leaves remain white.
